title: Frontend: Combination Sum
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Combination Sum. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution({candidates,target}). Distinct positive integer candidates can be reused. Return unique nondecreasing combinations summing to target, in ascending lexicographic traversal order. target=0 returns [[]].
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Sort validated positive candidates and backtrack from a start index.
alternativeApproaches: Implement a single-use variant and explain how advancing the recursive start index changes the search space.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Target zero; no solution; repeated use.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
